content: Current terrain/GIS references make map-based area selection, editable bounds, scale/area context, previews, generate/download actions, explicit output format, and error/progress feedback table stakes. Terrain2STL exposes movable/resizable region selection and terrain controls; TouchTerrain starts from map area selection; GeoLibre provides map controls, raster/WMS/COG loading, area measurement, CRS metadata, bbox extraction, 3D model loading, and bounded sidecar/client fallbacks. terrCVM should remain narrowly focused rather than reproducing a general GIS workbench.
